highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on the Skia m148 engine.
highlights_body: This release bundles the Skia m132–m148 engine upgrade, variable font and palette support, animated WebP encoding, and a reworked singleton lifecycle. It is a breaking release — review the changes below before upgrading from v3.

breaking.title: new SKFont() typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty, not null
breaking.body: Upstream m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont().MeasureText("Hello") now returns 0 and draws nothing. Pass an explicit typeface: new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect the unset state via font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default, not null
breaking.body: new SKPaint().Typeface is non-null. Text still works out of the box, but code that checked paint.Typeface == null to detect 'no typeface set' no longer fires. Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty or drop the check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns Default (not null) for missing families on Android
breaking.body: All platforms now consistently return SKTypeface.Default for an unknown family. For strict null semantics, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name) which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws OverflowException and is obsolete
breaking.body: The native offset is 32-bit. The Move(long) overload now uses a checked cast; out-of-range offsets throw OverflowException and the overload is marked [Obsolete]. Use Move(int) with a validated value.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts on Vulkan 1.0 (was: returns null)
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. Passing a 1.0 instance or leaving MaxAPIVersion at 0 causes SK_ABORT (process termination, not a catchable exception). Set apiVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on VkApplicationInfo and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion. Hardware that is strictly 1.0-only cannot use Ganesh Vulkan.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative: five interop fields removed
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice are removed. Use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions, and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures. Delete the other assignments.

breaking.title: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality; GRVkImageInfo property type renamed
breaking.body: GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable and the == / != operators are removed — use field-by-field comparison. GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo is now typed as GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (capitalisation change). Recompile to pick up these changes.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The protected setter is removed. Subclasses must use the constructor parameter or override the property getter.

breaking.title: SKPaint text/font members are now compile errors
breaking.body: The legacy text-drawing properties on SKPaint (TextSize, Typeface, etc.) deprecated in v3 now emit compile errors. Move these to SKFont.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine advances from 3.x's milestone to m148, incorporating the m132, m147, and m148 milestones along with two chrome/m147 upstream bug-fix syncs.

bullets.lead: Variable font and color font palette support
bullets.detail: Variable font axes, named instances, and color font palette enumeration and selection are now accessible through SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp.
SKWebpEncoder now supports creating multi-frame animated WebP files via SKWebpAnimEncoder.
SKStream.GetData() returns an SKData wrapping the stream's buffer without copying, useful for memory-mapped or in-memory streams.

bullets.lead: SKSamplingOptions overloads for SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface
bullets.detail: SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept an SKSamplingOptions parameter, giving control over the quality/speed trade-off when blitting surfaces.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzzSharp: HBColor struct and API additions
bullets.detail: Added HBColor for proper hb_color_t representation, missing API wrappers, and naming-convention fixes across the HarfBuzzSharp surface.
GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride and the correct axis for the (x, y) offset, fixing silent data corruption on non-tightly-packed bitmaps.
When an SKPathBuilder was garbage-collected before its SKPath, the path's finalizer could crash. Ownership is now tracked correctly.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 resolved
bullets.detail: The WinUI native projection DLL was absent for .NET 9 consumers; the package now correctly bundles the required asset.

bullets.lead: Default typeface resolution moved to managed layer
bullets.detail: Resolving a null typeface to the platform default now happens in managed code, restoring consistent text-measurement behavior across platforms including Android API 36+.
SKObject singletons are now tracked with weak references and re-created on demand, eliminating use-after-free crashes on app restart and reducing GC pressure.

bullets.lead: Native-compat gate moved to SkiaApi cctor
bullets.detail: The native library compatibility check now runs in the SkiaApi class constructor, making load failures easier to diagnose.

bullets.lead: Linux Bionic and Tizen native assets
bullets.detail: Native builds for Linux Bionic (Android NDK sysroot) and Tizen x64/arm64 are now included in the packages.
Emscripten builds for .NET 6 and .NET 7 are no longer included. The minimum WASM target is .NET 8.
Library packages use versioned TFMs (e.g. ios26.0) and app packages use unversioned ones (e.g. ios), aligning with .NET Apple TFM conventions.
Bundled expat updated to 2.8.1, libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1, harfbuzz to 14.2.0, freetype to 2.14.3, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, libpng to 1.6.58, and libexpat to 2.7.5, addressing known CVEs.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Singleton lifecycle rework, SKPaint text/font obsoletes promoted to errors, SKPath finalizer fix, variable font and WASM improvements, and Uno sample updates across four preview milestones.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native asset support and SKCanvas API additions.
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Community contribution to the v4 surface.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Android SKGLView tab-switch rendering fix in MAUI TabBar.

preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release Candidate 1 finalized the v4 API surface: SKPixmap pixel-access fixes, Skia m148 engine, singleton lifecycle rework, and legacy paint-member deprecation promotions to errors.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added the WASM build updates, libjpeg-turbo and expat security fixes, WinUI .NET 9 projection fix, and the HarfBuzzSharp API additions.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 introduced animated WebP encoding, SKStream.GetData, variable font and color palette APIs, and the singleton lifecycle groundwork.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line on Skia m147, establishing the engine baseline, TFM realignment, and the bulk of font lifecycle and API changes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 ships in this release with variable font support, color font palette APIs, a new HBColor struct for hb_color_t, and expanded API wrappers.
